We have carbon NMR shifts list. Carbonyl carbon typically around 160-220 ppm. Here we have a peak at 166.40 ppm, which likely corresponds to a carbonyl (C=O). Others are aromatic (~129) and aliphatic (~52, 43, 38). So number of carbonyl groups = 1.

We could verify with IR for C=O stretch, but carbon NMR already shows one carbonyl. To be safe, maybe check IR. Use ir_spectra tool.
